title: Dream Quarterfinal: Brazil vs Argentina Set to Light Up the Tournament
excerpt: Two South American giants prepare for an epic clash in the quarterfinals, with a place in the final four on the line in Dallas.
content:
The biggest game in world football is back, and it's on the biggest stage. Brazil and Argentina will renew their historic rivalry in the quarterfinals of the 2026 FIFA World Cup at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas.

### A Rivalry Like No Other
From Pelé vs Maradona to Messi vs Vinícius, this fixture has defined generations. Lionel Messi, fresh off winning the Copa América and the 2022 World Cup, leads Argentina into battle against a Brazil side that has looked unstoppable in this tournament so far.

### Brazil's Strength
The Seleção have scored 12 goals in their 4 matches, with Vinícius Júnior leading the way with 5 goals. Their attacking trident of Vinícius, Rodrygo, and Matheus Cunha has terrorized defenses.

### Argentina's Resolve
Argentina have ground out results, winning all 4 of their matches by a single goal. Their defense, led by Cristian Romero and Nicolás Otamendi, has been rock solid.

### A Packed House
Over 105,000 fans are expected at AT&T Stadium, making this one of the most attended matches in World Cup history. The atmosphere is sure to be electric.

title: Mexico Eliminate USA 2-1 in Extra Time in Classic Clash
excerpt: Hirving Lozano's 112th-minute goal sent Mexico into the quarterfinals and broke American hearts in a dramatic Round of 16 encounter in Houston.
content:
A classic CONCACAF rivalry lived up to the hype as Mexico defeated the United States 2-1 in extra time in a thrilling Round of 16 match at NRG Stadium in Houston.

### Electric Atmosphere
The stadium was split 50-50, with both sets of fans creating an incredible atmosphere. The USA took the lead in the 28th minute through Christian Pulisic, but Mexico equalized just before half-time thanks to a Santiago Giménez header.

### End-to-End Action
The second half was frantic, with both sides creating chances. The USA hit the post twice, and Mexico had a goal ruled out for offside. The match went to extra time.

### Lozano's Moment of Magic
In the 112th minute, Hirving Lozano produced a moment of individual brilliance, dribbling past three defenders before finishing coolly past Matt Turner. The Mexican end erupted, and El Tri held on for a famous victory.

### What's Next
Mexico advance to the quarterfinals to face France, while the USA's dream of a home World Cup comes to an end.

title: France Cruise Past Japan 3-0 to Reach Quarterfinals
excerpt: Kylian Mbappé scored twice as Les Bleus put in a clinical display to defeat Japan and set up a quarterfinal tie with Mexico.
content:
France showed why they are defending champions with a commanding 3-0 victory over Japan in the Round of 16 at Lincoln Financial Field in Philadelphia.

### Mbappé at His Best
Kylian Mbappé was unplayable, scoring in the 17th and 58th minutes. His first goal was a brilliant solo effort, and his second was a clinical finish from close range.

### Ousmane Dembélé added the third in the 72nd minute with a powerful shot from the edge of the area.

### Japan's Brave Effort
Japan, who had impressed in the group stage, fought hard but were ultimately outclassed by France's superior quality. They exit the tournament with their heads held high.

### France Look Strong
Les Bleus have yet to concede a goal in this tournament and look like the team to beat. Their quarterfinal against Mexico promises to be a classic.

title: England Edge Germany 1-0 in Tense Round of 16 Battle
excerpt: Jude Bellingham's 78th-minute goal was enough for England to defeat Germany and book their place in the quarterfinals.
content:
England claimed a historic victory over Germany, winning 1-0 in a tense and tactical Round of 16 match at Wembley Stadium (London, UK — a special venue for this tournament).

### A Tense Affair
The match was a cagey affair, with both sides creating few clear-cut chances. Germany had the better of the first half, but England grew into the game after the break.

### Bellingham's Winner
The decisive moment came in the 78th minute when Jude Bellingham rose highest to head home a Phil Foden corner. The Wembley crowd erupted, and England held on for a famous win.

### England's Quarterfinal
England will now face Spain in the quarterfinals, in what promises to be another huge European clash.

title: Round of 32 Recap: Shocks, Drama, and Goals Galore
excerpt: The first knockout round of the expanded 2026 World Cup did not disappoint, with shocks, comebacks, and incredible goals.
content:
The first ever 48-team World Cup knockout stage has concluded, and what a round it was! The Round of 32 gave us everything we could have wished for.

### The Shocks
Morocco were eliminated by Costa Rica, Senegal crashed out to Croatia, and Portugal were stunned by Japan in the biggest upset of the round.

### The Drama
There were late winners, penalty shootouts, and red cards. Mexico vs USA and England vs Germany were particular highlights.

### The Goals
We were treated to some stunning goals. Vinícius Júnior scored a brilliant solo effort, and Erling Haaland netted a hat-trick as Norway defeated Uruguay 4-1.

### The Quarterfinal Lineup
Brazil, Argentina, France, Mexico, England, Spain, Netherlands, and Norway are the eight teams left in the tournament.

title: Stunning Upset: Japan Knock Out Portugal 2-1 in Round of 32
excerpt: Junya Itō's stoppage-time winner sent Japan through and eliminated Portugal in one of the biggest shocks in World Cup history.
content:
Japan produced one of the greatest shocks in World Cup history, defeating Portugal 2-1 in the Round of 32 at BC Place in Vancouver.

### Portugal Take the Lead
Cristiano Ronaldo gave Portugal the lead in the 35th minute with a trademark header, and it looked like the European giants would cruise through.

### Japan Fight Back
But Japan had other ideas. Ritsu Dōan equalized in the 68th minute with a brilliant long-range strike, setting up a grandstand finish.

### Ito's Heroics
Deep into stoppage time, Junya Itō found the winner, sending the Japanese fans into delirium and breaking Portuguese hearts.

### A Historic Win
This is Japan's biggest ever World Cup win, and they become the first Asian team to reach the Round of 16 of a 48-team World Cup.

title: Brazil Cruise Past Scotland 3-0 to Win Group C
excerpt: Vinícius Júnior scored twice as Brazil secured top spot in Group C with a dominant 3-0 victory over Scotland in Miami.
content:
Brazil confirmed their status as one of the tournament favorites with a clinical 3-0 demolition of Scotland at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens, securing first place in Group C.

### Vinícius Júnior's Masterclass
The Real Madrid superstar opened the scoring in the 22nd minute with a trademark run from the left wing, cutting inside and curling the ball into the far corner. He added his second in the 51st minute, finishing a brilliant counter-attack to take his tournament tally to four goals.

### Cunha Completes the Rout
Matheus Cunha added the third in the 73rd minute with a composed finish, capping off a dominant display from the Seleção. Brazil finished the group stage with 7 points and a +5 goal difference.

### Scotland's World Cup Over
Despite a spirited first-half display, Scotland were outclassed after the break. They finish the group stage with 3 points — their first-ever World Cup win (against Haiti) providing a silver lining in what has been a historic campaign.

### What's Next
Brazil will face a third-placed team in the Round of 32, while Morocco advance as Group C runners-up.

title: Morocco Advance After Six-Goal Thriller Against Haiti
excerpt: Morocco's 4-2 victory over Haiti sealed their place in the Round of 32 as Group C runners-up in an entertaining encounter in Atlanta.
content:
Morocco's 2022 magic continued as they secured qualification for the knockout rounds with a thrilling 4-2 win over Haiti at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta.

### Atlas Lions Roar
Ismael Saibari opened the scoring early, but Haiti's Duckens Jean-Jacques equalized to send the underdogs' fans wild. Achraf Hakimi restored Morocco's lead before half-time with a stunning free-kick, and goals from Youssef En-Nesyri and Hakim Ziyech put the result beyond doubt.

### Haiti's Brave Exit
Frantzdy Pierrot pulled one back for Haiti in the 65th minute, and they finished the tournament with their heads held high. Making their first World Cup appearance in 52 years, they showed they belong on the world stage.

### Group C Final Standings
Brazil topped the group with 7 points, followed by Morocco (7pts, inferior goal difference), Scotland (3pts), and Haiti (0pts).

title: Mexico Complete Perfect Group Stage with 3-0 Win Over Czechia
excerpt: El Tri became the first team to win all three group matches at the 2026 World Cup, thrilling the home crowd at Estadio Azteca.
content:
Mexico completed a flawless group stage campaign with a commanding 3-0 victory over Czech Republic at Estadio Azteca, becoming the first team at this World Cup to achieve three wins from three.

### Azteca Fortress
The legendary Mexico City venue was at its intimidating best as Santiago Giménez opened the scoring in the 15th minute. Hirving Lozano and Julián Quiñones added further goals to seal a dominant display.

### Mexico's Statement
With 9 points and 7 goals scored, Mexico have announced themselves as genuine contenders. Playing in front of passionate home support, El Tri look capable of finally breaking their 'fifth game' curse.

### Czech Republic Eliminated
The Czech Republic finish bottom of Group A with just 1 point. Despite competitive performances, they lacked the cutting edge needed at this level.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo Makes History with Hat-Trick in Portugal's 5-0 Rout
excerpt: Ronaldo became the first man to score in six different World Cup editions as Portugal demolished Uzbekistan 5-0 in Houston.
content:
Cristiano Ronaldo etched his name further into football history by becoming the first male player to score in six different FIFA World Cup tournaments, netting a stunning hat-trick as Portugal thrashed Uzbekistan 5-0 at NRG Stadium.

### Record-Breaking Night
Ronaldo opened the scoring in the 8th minute with a trademark header, before adding a second from the penalty spot in the 34th minute. His hat-trick was completed in the 79th minute with a powerful free-kick that brought the Houston crowd to their feet.

### Silva and Leão Add Gloss
Bernardo Silva and Rafael Leão also found the net as Portugal ran riot against the Central Asian debutants. The result underlined Portugal's credentials as dark horse contenders.

### A Farewell Tour?
At 41 years old, this is almost certainly Ronaldo's final World Cup. But he's proving that age is just a number — his three goals take his all-time World Cup tally to 11.
